🧠 How early inflammation may contribute to Alzheimer’s developing decades later

Working groups at MPZPM, @FAU@mastodon.social and TUM are investigating a mechanism behind the development of disease that has been scarcely researched to date. The Volkswagen Foundation is funding the project with approximately 2.2 million euros.

Read more 👉🏼 https://mpzpm.mpg.de/news/news-details/how-early-inflammation-may-contribute-to-alzheimers-developing-decades-later
